name: activity-tree-open-hit-target
description: Dense activity rows pitch (~23.5px) below even the 28px desktop hit size, so OpenButton's deliberate overhang is capped on this surface: the [data-open-shell] rules in activitypanel.module.css stretch the shell into the row's content box and the button into the shell, keeping the 28px desktop / 44px phone hit WIDTH while the target never exceeds its own row's band. Consecutive rows' targets share no points (a tap near a boundary can never open a neighbor's transcript), a row with the control is exactly as tall as the plain reference row, and elementFromPoint reaches each sampled row's own Open at its center and exposed edges - first, middle, and last rows, at desktop and phone sizes.

mutation.note: Without the cap the shell keeps its 28px/44px height on a ~23.5px row pitch: consecutive targets overlap (maxOverlap > 0.5), targets escape their own rows' bands, and the middle row's boundary probes can resolve to a neighbor's button.
